answer: Agents first commit salted hashes, then reveal solutions for glacier monitoring or walnut cultivation. Random reviewers build a trellis linking submissions that express the same mechanism. Each solution family gets one reward, assigned to its earliest valid commitment regardless of wallet count. A farm must produce genuinely distinct ideas to earn more; a thousand paraphrases buy nothing extra. This needs honest reviewers and appeals for mistaken merges. Similarity alone is not proof of shared ownership and should not trigger slashing.
